name: update
about: A 15-25 s update film ("vX is out"): the name and the version centred, 2-4 changes each on its own beat shape (the changed element growing into the colour field the line stands on, the card small in its line's gap, or the card above its line), the card carried from change to change, a recap of every change, the version mark built from it. The camera never floats and nothing bobs or tilts. The film fills src/update.ts only; every slot deals one of its devices per film (src/deal.ts), creative library devices (fx/creative) among them. new-film.sh --format update lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every update film is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film, its biggest entry on the recap and its final hit on the version mark; earshot effects mark the UI (taps, highlights, state changes); never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 112-128 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track)
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --format update --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py fit --end auto  (once update.ts is written: the edit is fitted to the film's bars, the track's entry on the recap's bar, its own ending, else one ringing hit, on the version mark)

next: update film: write src/update.ts, the one file the film fills: the version and the one before it, 2-4 changes, each one plain sentence (2-6 words, a result the user sees), its screen's title and the moment that proves it:

tap (an action and the state it changes to), fill (a list, grid or week that fills), swap (before -> after) or count (a figure that rises), in the product's own words; real photos: node scripts/assets.mjs get,
the deal follows the name: the command in template.json deal.print (PIN a slot, or SEED to re-deal),
the type pairing: npx tsx scripts/type-deal.ts --seed "<name>" (fx/TypePairs), unless the brand brings its own face,
then the track: track.py fit --end auto cuts it to these bars (template.json music)

deal.seed: the product's name (IDENTITY.name), or SEED in src/deal.ts; PIN chooses a slot by hand
deal.print: npx tsx -e "import { DEAL, DEAL_SOURCE, LINES, CARD_TONE } from './src/deal'; console.log(DEAL_SOURCE, JSON.stringify(DEAL), 'cards', CARD_TONE, 'voice', LINES.voice, 'exit', LINES.exitVoice)"

ground.nearWhite: a paper sweep lit from the top left
ground.lightStudio: a light grey studio sweep: a top key over a falling floor
ground.softSky: a pale sky, deeper at the top
ground.gradientField: a pale tinted mesh: two lobes of the field hue from opposite corners
ground.blackField: studio black under one soft key from above left
ground.studio: a mid slate cyclorama: a broad top key over a slate floor
ground.deepPool: a deep field at the accent hue with a glow rising from the bottom edge
ground.duskMesh: a deep tinted night: two lobes of the field hue
ground.floorGlow: near-black with one glow of the field hue rising from the floor

hook.roll: "[Name] [old version]" centred; the changed numerals roll on a drum to the new version once the name is read
hook.rise: the name, then the version rising out of a mask in its place beside it (the pair centred from the first frame)
hook.badge: the name alone, centred; a dot lands after it and grows into the pill that carries the version (the end card keeps the pill)

order.after: the change works, then the element that changed (the pressed button, the block, the row, the last bar) grows into the frame's colour field, the line reads on it, and the field closes into the next card (the film's one colour event)
order.split: the line arrives parted round the card, which sits small in the gap between its words (the change before it as it ended); the words leave and the card grows out of the gap as the new screen and works
order.with: the card works in the upper 60 % of the frame while its line reads centred under it

end.stack: the recap's cards slide onto each other at the centre and the pile shrinks into the mark; the name slides out of it, the version lands on the last bar line
end.fold: the other cards tuck behind the last one at the centre, which shrinks into the mark; then the name and the version

lines.moves: every line on one move (mask, fall or crisp) and one whole-line exit (lift or recede), dealt per film: no line travels sideways or leaves word by word

arrive.rise: the first card rises into place as the name lifts away, whole within the move's first fifth
arrive.open: a hairline at the centre grows across and opens down into the first card

recap.deal: the carried card lands in the recap row and the other changes slide out from behind it
recap.rise: the carried card lands in the recap row as the other changes rise into their places

cards.light: kit/card light material on any ground
cards.dark: on a dark ground only, dealt: kit/card dark material, 8-12 L* over the ground (src/deal.ts CARD_TONE)
